d55c968084e38564e352a783a274586f09b9165e: A resort on a human scale, Hoch-Ybrig focuses on friendly service and proximity rather than impressive figures. Its 50 km of runs are well suited to a stay of 3 to 4 days, especially for families or skiers who don't need to constantly change their playground. Hoch-Ybrig's family reputation is well earned: dedicated beginner areas, a well-organised childcare service, well-groomed green runs and a good-natured atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. Hoch-Ybrig's moderate altitude — starting at 1040 m, with the summit at 1831 m — makes it sensitive to climate variations. January and February remain the safest months for optimal snow cover. Outside this window, checking snow reports before you leave is strongly advised. The budget for a stay at Hoch-Ybrig is clearly high: €66 for a day lift pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants that are among the most expensive in the Alps. It is the price of excellence, but you should be aware of it before you go. In short, Hoch-Ybrig keeps its promises. A Northern Alps resort that will suit most profiles without disappointing.
